Document password length requirements for password reset confirm in docs/API.md
args.body:

args.title: Validate integer environment variables in src/config.ts to reject trailing characters
args.body:
File: src/config.ts

Validate in `int` or `loadConfig` that time/integer environment variables do not contain trailing unit letters (such as 'h') or parse them properly, throwing an error if invalid instead of falling back to Number.parseInt's truncated result.

label: bug
file: src/i18n/index.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The pickLocale function currently iterates through the comma-separated parts of the Accept-Language header in order while ignoring q quality values. We need to parse Accept-Language q-values or sort matching locales by weight so that the language with the highest quality value is selected.

File: src/api/reports.ts

Add name filtering support to the reports list endpoint and report repository so that clients can filter reports by name.
args.title: Add name filtering support to reports list endpoint and repository

args.body:
label: docs
file: docs/API.md
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The API documentation in docs/API.md for POST /auth/password-reset/confirm does not mention any password complexity or length requirements, whereas src/api/auth.ts enforces a length of 10 to 200 characters. Update docs/API.md to document the password length requirement (at least 10 characters, up to 200) for POST /auth/password-reset/confirm.

label: bug
file: src/config.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

`int()` in `src/config.ts` uses `Number.parseInt(raw, 10)` without checking for trailing characters like 'h', so `12h` parses as `12` without raising an error. We should validate that time/integer environment variables do not contain trailing unit letters or parse them properly, throwing an error if invalid.

label: feature
file: src/api/reports.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

src/api/reports.ts implements GET /reports by invoking reportRepo.list without any query parameters for filtering by report name. Add name filtering support to the reports list endpoint and report repository.

label: question
file: none
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The health check endpoint in src/api/health.ts intentionally returns HTTP 200 for a 'degraded' status and only returns HTTP 503 when the status is 'down'. Therefore, load balancer health probes should inspect the JSON body's status field ('ok' vs 'degraded' vs 'down') rather than relying solely on the HTTP status code.
